<!-- generated by docs/generate.sh - edit the javadoc in src/, not this file -->

A property is written on an element the way an html attribute is. Every element takes every property
here; what differs is which of them do anything, which the
[elements reference](/ctml/reference/elements) lists per element.

A boolean property needs no value: `draggable` on its own is the same as `draggable="true"`. Every
string is read through the dom context, so `${name}` anywhere in one is the variable of that name as
it stands this frame.

## `class`

The tailwind-like class list the element is styled from. Reading it again replaces everything the classes said before, which is what lets a callback show a box it had hidden; the property holds the list as it stands, so adding or taking away one class is an edit to that string.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ClassName` |

```html
class="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700"
```

## `text`

The words the element shows. It is read through the dom context, so ${name} anywhere in it is the variable of that name as it stands this frame.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Text` |

```html
text="fps ${fps}"
```

## `draggable`

Lets the element be dragged around inside its parent's content box. Just the name is enough: <div draggable>.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Draggable` |

```html
<div class="w-8 h-8 bg-sky-600" draggable></div>
```

## `id`

The name a script can find the element again by, which is what getElementById looks up. An element given none gets one handed out in order the first time the context needs it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ID` |

```html
id="cookie-counter"
```

## `callback`

The name of a function the host put in the dom context. It hears about everything that happens to the element, not only the presses, so one that cares which is which asks the callback it is handed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Callback` |

```html
callback="clickCookie"
```

## `colspan`

How many columns of its table a cell takes up. It belongs to the cell, not to how it looks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | td, th |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ColSpan` |

```html
<td colspan="2" text="both columns"></td>
```

## `rowspan`

How many rows of its table a cell takes up, the rows under it making room for it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | td, th |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.RowSpan` |

```html
<td rowspan="3" text="three rows"></td>
```

## `scrollx`

How far the content inside the element is scrolled sideways, which is how a script scrolls it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollX` |

```html
scrollx="40"
```

## `scrolly`

How far the content inside the element is scrolled down, which is how a script scrolls it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollY` |

```html
scrolly="120"
```

## `scrollinto`

The id of a descendant to bring into view, which is css's scrollIntoView. Set rather than read: whatever lays the element out takes the value off it, scrolls there and leaves it empty again.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | any element that scrolls |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.ScrollInto` |

```html
scrollinto="last-row"
```

## `src`

The image an element shows, as the identifier a texture is held under: "craftytml:textures/gui/a.png".

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | string |
| Applies to | img |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Source` |

```html
src="minecraft:textures/item/diamond.png"
```

## `tabindex`

Where the element comes in the tab order, the way html's tabindex does it: zero puts it in at its place in the markup, a positive number puts it ahead of those in that number's order, and below zero takes it out of the order while leaving it something a press can still focus.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | any element |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.TabIndex` |

```html
tabindex="-1"
```

## `start`

What an ordered list counts from, which is one unless it says otherwise.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | ol |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Start` |

```html
<ol start="5"></ol>
```

## `reversed`

Whether an ordered list counts down instead of up.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | boolean |
| Applies to | ol |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Reversed` |

```html
<ol start="3" reversed></ol>
```

## `value`

The number of one list item, which the items after it carry on from.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Value | integer |
| Applies to | li |
| Java class | `net.tutla.craftytml.client.ctml.property.Value` |

```html
<li value="10">ten</li>
```
